features.text: GetAssignments: Get project's assignment items. (GET /tasks/{name}/assignments)
PostAssignment: Adds a new assignment to a project and returns assignment item in a response. (POST /tasks/{name}/assignments)
GetAssignment: Read project assignment with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/assignments/{assignmentUid})
DeleteAssignment: Deletes a project assignment with all references to it. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/assignments/{assignmentUid})
PutAssignment: Updates resources assignment with the specified Uid. (PUT /tasks/{name}/assignments/{assignmentUid})
GetAssignmentTimephasedData: Get timescaled data for an assignment with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/assignments/{assignmentUid}/timeScaleData)
GetCalendars: Read project calendar items. (GET /tasks/{name}/calendars)
PostCalendar: Adds a new calendar to project file. (POST /tasks/{name}/calendars)
PutCalendar: Edits an existing project calendar. (PUT /tasks/{name}/calendars)
GetCalendar: Get a project's calendar with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/calendars/{calendarUid})
DeleteCalendar: Deletes a project calendar (DELETE /tasks/{name}/calendars/{calendarUid})
GetCalendarExceptions: Get a list of calendar's exceptions. (GET /tasks/{name}/calendars/{calendarUid}/calendarExceptions)
PostCalendarException: Adds a new calendar exception to a calendar. (POST /tasks/{name}/calendars/{calendarUid}/calendarExceptions)
PutCalendarException: Updates calendar exception. (PUT /tasks/{name}/calendars/{calendarUid}/calendarExceptions/{index})
DeleteCalendarException: Deletes calendar exception from calendar exceptions collection. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/calendars/{calendarUid}/calendarExceptions/{index})
GetCalendarWorkWeeks: Gets the collection of work weeks of the specified calendar. (GET /tasks/{name}/calendars/{calendarUid}/workWeeks)

GetCriticalPath: Returns the list of the tasks which must be completed on time for a project to finish on schedule. Each task of the project is represented as a task item here, which is light-weighted task representation of the project task.. (GET /tasks/{name}/criticalPath)
GetTaskDocument: Get a project document. (GET /tasks/{name})
GetTaskDocumentWithFormat: Get a project document in the specified format (GET /tasks/{name}/format)
GetProjectIds: Get Uids of projects contained in the file. (GET /tasks/{name}/projectids)

GetPageCount: Returns page count for the project to be rendered using given Timescale and PresentationFormat 
or specified PageSize. (GET /tasks/{name}/pagecount)
PutImportProjectFromFile: Imports project from primavera db formats (Primavera SQLite .db or Primavera xml) and saves it to specified file with the specified format. (PUT /tasks/{name}/import)
PutImportProjectFromDb: Imports project from database with the specified connection string and saves it to specified file with the specified format. (PUT /tasks/importfromdb)
PutImportProjectFromProjectOnline: Imports project from Project Online and saves it to specified file. (PUT /tasks/{name}/importfromprojectonline)
GetDocumentProperties: Get a collection of a project's document properties. (GET /tasks/{name}/documentproperties)
GetDocumentProperty: Get a document property by name. (GET /tasks/{name}/documentproperties/{propertyName})
PutDocumentProperty: Set/create document property. (PUT /tasks/{name}/documentproperties/{propertyName})
PostDocumentProperty: Set/create document property. (POST /tasks/{name}/documentproperties/{propertyName})
GetExtendedAttributes: Get a project's extended attributes. (GET /tasks/{name}/extendedAttributes)

PutExtendedAttribute: Add a new extended attribute definition to a project or 
updates existing attribute definition (with the same FieldId). (PUT /tasks/{name}/extendedAttributes)
GetExtendedAttributeByIndex: Get a project extended attribute definition with the specified index. (GET /tasks/{name}/extendedAttributes/{index})
DeleteExtendedAttributeByIndex: Delete a project extended attribute. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/extendedAttributes/{index})
GetTaskGroups: Read the task group definitions of a project. (GET /tasks/{name}/taskGroups)
GetTaskGroup: Read a project's task group definition with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/taskGroups/{groupUid})
GetResourceGroups: Read the resource group definitions of a project. (GET /tasks/{name}/resourceGroups)
GetResourceGroup: Read a project's resource group definition with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/resourceGroups/{groupUid})
GetGroupedTasks: Returns the project tasks grouped according to the specified task group definition. (GET /tasks/{name}/taskGroups/{groupUid}/tasks)
GetGroupedResources: Returns the project resources grouped according to the specified resource group definition. (GET /tasks/{name}/resourceGroups/{groupUid}/resources)
GetOutlineCodes: Get a project's outline codes. (GET /tasks/{name}/outlineCodes)
GetOutlineCodeByIndex: Get outline code by index. (GET /tasks/{name}/outlineCodes/{index})
DeleteOutlineCodeByIndex: Deletes a project outline code (DELETE /tasks/{name}/outlineCodes/{index})
CreateNewProject: Creates new project in Project Server\Project Online instance. (POST /tasks/projectOnline/{siteUrl}/{name})
UpdateProject: Updates existing project in Project Server\Project Online instance. The existing project will be overwritten. (PUT /tasks/projectOnline/{siteUrl}/{name})
GetProjectList: Gets the list of published projects in the current Project Online account. (GET /tasks/projectOnline/projectList)
PutRecalculateProject: Reschedules all project tasks ids, outline levels, start/finish dates, sets early/late dates, calculates slacks, work and cost fields. (PUT /tasks/{name}/recalculate/project)
PutRecalculateProjectWorkAsComplete: Recalculate project work as complete (PUT /tasks/{name}/recalculate/projectWorkAsComplete)
PutRecalculateProjectUncompleteWorkToStartAfter: Recalculate project uncomplete work (PUT /tasks/{name}/recalculate/uncompleteWorkToStartAfter)
PutRecalculateProjectResourceFields: Recalculate project resource fields (PUT /tasks/{name}/recalculate/resourceFields)
GetReportPdf: Returns created report in PDF format. (GET /tasks/{name}/report)

LevelTasks: Levels tasks for project’s resources. If request body is empty, 
all project's resources with default leveling options will be leveled. (PUT /tasks/{name}/resourceLevel)

ClearLeveling: Clears leveling delays that was previously added to the project during resource leveling. 
If request body is empty, all leveling delays will be cleared. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/resourceLevel)
GetResources: Get a project's resources. (GET /tasks/{name}/resources)
PostResource: Add a new resource to a project. (POST /tasks/{name}/resources)
GetResource: Get project resource. (GET /tasks/{name}/resources/{resourceUid})
PutResource: Updates resource with the specified Uid (PUT /tasks/{name}/resources/{resourceUid})
DeleteResource: Deletes a project resource with all references to it (DELETE /tasks/{name}/resources/{resourceUid})
GetResourceAssignments: Get resource's assignments. (GET /tasks/{name}/resources/{resourceUid}/assignments)
GetResourceTimephasedData: Get timescaled data for a resource with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/resources/{resourceUid}/timeScaleData)
GetRiskAnalysisReport: Performs a risk analysys using Monte Carlo simulation and creates a risk analysis report. (GET /tasks/{name}/riskAnalysisReport)
GetTasks: Get a project's tasks. (GET /tasks/{name}/tasks)
PostTask: Add a new task to a project. (POST /tasks/{name}/tasks)
GetTask: Read project task. (GET /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid})
DeleteTask: Deletes a project task with all references to it and rebuilds tasks tree. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid})
PutTask: Updates special task getting by task UID (PUT /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid})
GetTaskAssignments: Get task assignments. (GET /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid}/assignments)
GetTaskTimephasedData: Get timescaled data for a task with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid}/timeScaleData)
GetPrimaveraTaskProperties: Get primavera properties for a task with the specified Uid. (GET /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid}/primaveraProperties)
GetTaskRecurringInfo: Get recurring info for a task with the specified Uid (GET /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid}/recurringInfo)
PutTaskRecurringInfo: Updates existing task's recurring info. Note that task should be already recurring. (PUT /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid}/recurringInfo)
PostTaskRecurringInfo: Adds a new recurring task. (POST /tasks/{name}/tasks/recurringInfo)
PostTasks: Create multiple tasks by single request. (POST /tasks/{name}/tasks/batch)
PutMoveTaskToSibling: Move a task to another position under the same parent and the same outline level (PUT /tasks/{name}/tasks/{taskUid}/moveToSibling)
GetTaskLinks: Get tasks' links of a project. (GET /tasks/{name}/taskLinks)
PostTaskLink: Adds a new task link to a project. (POST /tasks/{name}/taskLinks)
PutTaskLink: Updates existing task link. (PUT /tasks/{name}/taskLinks/{index})
DeleteTaskLink: Delete task link. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/taskLinks/{index})
GetVbaProject: Returns VBA project. (GET /tasks/{name}/vbaproject)
ClearVba: Clears all VBA macros from the project. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/vbaproject)
GetVbaModule: Returns VBA module by name or index. (GET /tasks/{name}/vbaproject/modules/{module})
PutVbaModule: Updates a VBA module's source code. (PUT /tasks/{name}/vbaproject/modules/{module})
DeleteVbaModule: Deletes a VBA module. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/vbaproject/modules/{module})
PostVbaModule: Adds a new VBA module. (POST /tasks/{name}/vbaproject/modules)
GetViews: Read all project views. (GET /tasks/{name}/views)
GetAllTableTextStyles: Read all table text styles from specified view. (GET /tasks/{name}/views/{viewUid}/tabletextstyles)
CreateTableTextStyle: Create table text style in specified view. (POST /tasks/{name}/views/{viewUid}/tabletextstyles)
UpdateTableTextStyle: Update table text style in specified view. (PUT /tasks/{name}/views/{viewUid}/tabletextstyles)
GetTableTextStyle: Read specified table text style from specified view. (GET /tasks/{name}/views/{viewUid}/tabletextstyles/{rowUid})
DeleteTableTextStyle: Delete specified table text style from specified view. (DELETE /tasks/{name}/views/{viewUid}/tabletextstyles/{rowUid})
GetWbsDefinition: Get a project's WBS Definition. (GET /tasks/{name}/wbsDefinition)
PutRenumberWbsCode: Renumber WBS code of passed tasks (if specified) or all project's tasks. (PUT /tasks/{name}/renumberWbsCode)
